registryBasis: First-party Hải Dương ward/local-government notices identify the local public authority conducting cadastral measurement, cadastral-map preparation, cadastral records and land-database completion. Provincial legal material identifies Văn phòng đăng ký đất đai and its branches as responsible for cadastral extracts, updates and land-database operation. This establishes local custody/procedure, not an open parcel geometry API.

officialSources.observation: Official local-government notice dated 2026-09-08: cadastral measurement, cadastral records and land-database completion are underway; no map/API link is exposed.

Official local-government report describes re-survey, new survey and cadastral correction for named parcel groups; it states HN72 and national-reference survey context but provides no downloadable parcel features.

Official Hải Dương legal database text assigns cadastral extracts, land-database updates and operation to land-registration offices/branches; it is institutional/legal evidence, not a public data service.
